originality.rationale: The nearest width-specific primary proof is confined to regular simplices; an own-recorded integer hypersimplex result covers only integral levels. Capped-simplex algorithm work addresses projection onto the object, not its least directional width. Direct full-text and semantic comparisons expose no all-real-level theorem; residual priority risks remain.
residual_risks: Unindexed classical treatments of symmetric permutahedron minimum widths may give an equivalent continuous-level identity.
Semantic published-finding corpus queries, even when comprehensive among relevant terms, cannot certify global mathematical priority.
